status: artifact-only prototype; not shipped, not adopted, and not independently critiqued

source.form: Two hollow copper loops separated by a transparent row; short central rootwood mast; one amber core; three stepped legs with three separated two-pixel feet.

sourceEncodingPlan.ifLaterApproved: Ship the original SVG directly as the public visual asset, preserving its 13x13 viewBox and transparent alpha; keep an identical authored copy under demo/assets/buried-coil-revealed.svg and the served copy under public/assets/buried-coil-revealed.svg, then register the SVG dimensions, bytes, license, authorship and SHA-256. Direct SVG at CSS 13x13 matches the native prototype path. Do not derive product art from the 13px screenshot.
sourceEncodingPlan.rasterFallback: A 520x520 SVG raster and lossless WebP were tested at CSS 13x13; Chromium produced 129 differing RGBA pixels versus direct SVG. Do not use this WebP route unless a future export/runtime pairing is separately resolved and verified.

nativeEvidence.geometryEvidence: The outer ring rows are separated by an entirely transparent row; each of the final two rows contains three independent three-pixel feet with one transparent column between them. At the preceding row, the three leg groups are separate.
nativeEvidence.status: Native geometry recorded for independent review; no PASS or adoption claim.
